question: What is the meaning of resource taxation in relation to life cycle assessment (lca)?
description: Resource taxation refers to the financial burden imposed on the use of natural resources, such as raw materials, energy, and water, throughout the life cycle of a product or system. In the context of Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), resource taxation can be considered as an environmental impact category, as it reflects the economic costs associated with the extraction, processing, and disposal of these resources. This aspect is often included in LCA studies to evaluate the environmental and economic performance of products and systems.
